components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #285F86; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285F86; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="房间号" placeholder="房间号">
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #C4D2DE; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A3149; font: 16px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #3B6D91; border-color: #285F86; }

narrative.overview: Clear groupings and a restrained blue-grey palette keep room actions and game state easy to find.

rules.name: Semantic color
rules.body: Use state and faction colors for their meanings, not decoration.

dos: Use shared tokens and preserve accessible contrast.
donts: Do not add decorative gradients or colored side stripes.
